ruling: founder, 2026-10-31: the Oracle k3s spine is Rust-only. A production service that targets the spine is written in Rust; a service containing Python is rejected at the admission gate.
denial_message: ADMISSION DENIED: Services targeting the k3s spine must be written in Rust.
readme: Every entry below is a LEGACY Python image that already runs on, or ships toward, the spine
on the day the ruling landed. Each one is grandfathered so the gate does not break the estate
today. Grandfathering is not permission to grow: an entry names the image, its owner, the
reason it still exists, and the date by which it must be ported to Rust or removed from the
spine. Nothing is added here silently -- a new entry is a recorded decision with a reason.
Images built in other repositories need their own policy/rust-only-allowlist.json before
that repository's gate lands; the shared engine (platform/estate/libexec/rust-only-admission.py)
reads the allowlist of the repository it is asked about.
